title: UniETP: Unifying Environments for Generalizable Embodied Task Planning
summary: This paper focuses on the problem of Embodied Task Planning, where an agent is required to execute a sequence of atomic actions within an interactive environment to complete a user-specified task. Though a variety of simulators and datasets have previously been built for this task, these efforts are largely isolated, with each using its own observation format, action type, and task domain. This fragmentation complicates comprehensive model evaluation and hinders the scalability of training data. As an effort towards generalizable embodied planning, we propose UniETP, a unified interface integrating four commonly-used simulators (AI2-THOR, VirtualHome, Habitat, BEHAVIOR). UniETP is characterized by both standardization and diversity. On one hand, it formalizes all the simulators into a consistent observation and action space, and builds an evaluation system to support complicated task goal. On the other hand, it enhances task diversity and complexity across dimensions like task logic, instance grounding, and instruction understanding, constructing a new dataset with varied levels of difficulty in an automatic manner. Extensive experiments on the proposed benchmark are conducted to evaluate the embodied planning capabilities of recent models and analyze the performance bottlenecks. Codes and data will be available at https://github.com/woyut/UniETP .
tldr: This paper proposes UniETP, a unified interface that integrates four embodied simulators and standardizes observation/action spaces to support generalizable embodied task planning research.
tldr_zh: 本文提出UniETP，一个统一接口，集成了四个具身模拟器并标准化观察/动作空间，以支持可泛化的具身任务规划研究。
summary_zh: 本文聚焦具身任务规划问题，即要求智能体在交互环境中执行一系列原子动作以完成用户指定的任务。尽管此前已有多种模拟器和数据集为此任务构建，但这些工作大多相互孤立，各自采用不同的观测格式、动作类型及任务领域。这种碎片化现象导致模型全面评估复杂化，并限制了训练数据的可扩展性。为推进通用化具身规划研究，我们提出UniETP——一个集成四种常用模拟器（AI2-THOR、VirtualHome、Habitat、BEHAVIOR）的统一接口。UniETP兼具标准化与多样性特征：一方面，它将所有模拟器规范化为一致的观测与动作空间，并构建了支持复杂任务目标的评估体系；另一方面，它在任务逻辑、实例锚定、指令理解等维度增强了任务多样性与复杂度，以自动化方式构建了包含多级难度的新数据集。基于该基准的大量实验全面评估了最新模型的具身规划能力，分析了性能瓶颈。代码与数据将在https://github.com/woyut/UniETP 公开。

title: RoboHarness: Memory-Driven Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Policies for Long-Horizon Planning
summary: Long-horizon robotic tasks require diverse capabilities that no single policy can reliably provide. Heterogeneous policies offer complementary strengths, but orchestrating them requires reasoning over uncertain capability boundaries and cross-policy distribution mismatch, which are largely overlooked by existing planning methods built on homogeneous, predefined skills with fixed applicability. We propose RoboHarness, a unified framework that encapsulates independently developed robot control systems as reusable agentic skills. Although instantiated in this work with VLAs, RL policies, and task-and-motion planning (TAMP) systems, RoboHarness is designed as a general framework compatible with a broader range of robot policies, such as navigation policies, model predictive controllers, and world-action models. RoboHarness uses multi-modal execution memory and online evidence to characterize policy capability boundaries for capability-aware decomposition and routing. To stabilize policy handoffs, its Memory Bridge retrieves execution trajectories associated with the next policy, estimates its in-distribution state region, and guides the robot toward that region without joint policy retraining. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks, 500 customized tasks, and 135 real-robot experiments demonstrate effective capability-aware routing and stable policy orchestration, yielding substantial improvements in zero-shot long-horizon planning and out-of-distribution robustness.
tldr: RoboHarness is a framework for orchestrating heterogeneous robot policies (VLAs, RL, TAMP) using multi-modal memory to characterize policy capabilities and stabilize handoffs via in-distribution state guidance, enabling zero-shot long-horizon planning.
tldr_zh: RoboHarness是一个通过多模态记忆来表征异构机器人策略（VLA、强化学习、TAMP）的能力边界，并利用分布内状态引导稳定策略切换的框架，实现了零样本长时程规划。
summary_zh: 长时域机器人任务需要多种能力，单一策略无法可靠提供。异构策略具有互补优势，但协调这些策略需要对不确定的能力边界和跨策略分布不匹配进行推理，而现有基于同质化、预定义技能且适用性固定的规划方法往往忽略了这些因素。我们提出RoboHarness，一个统一的框架，将独立开发的机器人控制系统封装为可重用的智能体技能。虽然本文通过VLA、强化学习策略以及任务与运动规划（TAMP）系统实现了该框架，但RoboHarness被设计为通用框架，兼容更广泛的机器人策略，如导航策略、模型预测控制器和世界-动作模型。RoboHarness利用多模态执行记忆和在线证据来表征策略能力边界，实现能力感知的任务分解与路由。为稳定策略切换，其记忆桥模块检索与下一策略关联的执行轨迹，估计其分布内状态区域，并引导机器人朝向该区域运动，而无需联合策略再训练。在三个公开基准测试、500个定制任务以及135个真实机器人实验上的大量实验表明，该方法实现了有效的能力感知路由和稳定的策略编排，在零样本长时域规划和分布外鲁棒性方面取得了显著提升。

title: Closing the Loop in Humanoid VLA: Persistent 3D Object Tokens for Verifiable Loco-Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action policies are a promising foundation for general robot control, but long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires the robot to treat task objects as persistent physical entities across movement, contact, occlusion, and recovery. We study this problem as object-state divergence: the object state used to condition a whole-body action can differ from the state used to decide whether the action achieved the intended physical relation. We propose \emph{Persistent Object Tokenization} (POT), which maintains role-indexed 3D object records from RGB-D observations and converts them into object tokens for a whole-body action expert. Instantiated as \emph{POT-VLA}, the same object records condition action generation and support geometric predicate checks, yielding a closed-loop execution system in which object state is both actionable and verifiable. On a Unitree G1, POT-VLA improves a matched direct GR00T-N1.7 baseline from 39/80 to 71/80 successes over eight real-world task families. In an external Being-0-aligned reference, POT-VLA achieves 44/50 successes on aligned service tasks, compared with the 37/50 success reported by the Being-0 paper. The largest gains occur on tasks requiring maintained 3D relations, suggesting that persistent object-centered state is a useful abstraction for verifiable humanoid VLA execution.
tldr: Proposes Persistent Object Tokenization (POT), which maintains 3D object tokens from RGB-D to condition whole-body actions and enable verifiable geometric predicates, achieving large gains on humanoid loco-manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出持久化物体标记化（POT），从RGB-D中维护3D物体标记以条件化全身动作并支持可验证几何谓词，在人形机器人操作任务上取得显著提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作策略是通用机器人控制的有前景的基础，但在长时域人形机器人操作-移动联合任务中，机器人需要将任务对象视为在运动、接触、遮挡和恢复过程中保持一致的物理实体。我们将该问题建模为对象状态偏差：用于调节全身动作的对象状态，可能与用于判断该动作是否达到预期物理关系的状态不一致。为此，我们提出**持久化对象标记化**（POT），该方法从RGB-D观测中维护带有角色索引的3D对象记录，并将其转换为面向全身动作专家的对象标记。以**POT-VLA**实例化的形式，相同的对象记录同时为动作生成提供条件，并支持几何谓词检查，从而构建一个对象状态既可操作又可验证的闭环执行系统。在Unitree G1机器人上，POT-VLA在8个真实世界任务族中将匹配的GR00T-N1.7基线从39/80成功率提升至71/80。在与外部Being-0对齐的参考基准中，POT-VLA在对齐服务任务上取得了44/50的成功率，而Being-0论文报告的成功率为37/50。最大性能提升出现在需要维持3D关系的任务上，这表明以对象为中心的持久化状态是人形机器人可验证VLA执行的有效抽象。

title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
summary: We present RynnBrain 1.1, a family of embodied foundation models spanning 2B, 9B, and 122B-A10B scales. Trained with a unified spatio-temporal and physically grounded framework, RynnBrain 1.1 supports embodied perception, spatial reasoning, localization, and planning. Compared with RynnBrain 1.0, it further introduces contact-point prediction across the model family and native 3D grounding for the 2B and 9B models, yielding representations and outputs that are more directly aligned with robot manipulation. We also develop RynnBrain-VLA with a unified cross-embodiment action space and embodiment-specific masking, and deploy it on Unitree G1, Astribot-S1, and Tianji-Wuji. RynnBrain 1.1 achieves strong results on embodied cognition, localization, and 3D grounding, with the 122B-A10B model outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source models on VSI-Bench, MMSI, and RefSpatial-Bench. Real-robot experiments show that RynnBrain-initialized policies outperform Qwen-based and representative generalist VLAs, while joint multi-task and multi-embodiment training improves process scores and success rates over per-task training.
tldr: RynnBrain 1.1 introduces embodied foundation models with unified spatio-temporal and physically grounded training, adding contact-point prediction and native 3D grounding, and deploys a cross-embodiment VLA policy on multiple real robots, outperforming prior models on embodied benchmarks and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: RynnBrain 1.1 提出了具有统一时空与物理基础训练的具身基础模型，新增接触点预测与原生3D定位能力，并在多个实体机器人上部署跨本体的VLA策略，在具身基准测试与机器人实验中优于此前模型。
summary_zh: 我们提出了RynnBrain 1.1，这是一个包含2B、9B和122B-A10B三种规模的具身基础模型系列。通过统一的时空与物理基础框架进行训练，RynnBrain 1.1支持具身感知、空间推理、定位与规划。相较于RynnBrain 1.0，该版本进一步在全模型系列中引入了接触点预测功能，并为2B和9B模型提供了原生3D定位能力，从而生成更直接适配机器人操作的表示与输出。我们还开发了具有统一跨具身动作空间与具身特定掩码的RynnBrain-VLA，并将其部署于Unitree G1、Astribot-S1和Tianji-Wuji平台上。RynnBrain 1.1在具身认知、定位与3D定位方面取得了优异成果，其中122B-A10B模型在VSI-Bench、MMSI和RefSpatial-Bench基准测试中超越了所有参与评估的专有模型与开源模型。真实机器人实验表明，基于RynnBrain初始化的策略优于基于Qwen的通用VLA及代表性通用VLA，同时联合多任务与多具身训练相比单任务训练在过程评分与成功率上均有提升。

title: GeoWorldAD: Geometry World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires both safe and efficient planning decisions in dynamic 3D environments. Although recent Vision/Video-Action models learn policies directly from visual observations and scale well with advances in vision transformers and large-scale training data, they often lack explicit geometric grounding and future-aware spatial guidance, limiting their ability to balance collision avoidance and driving progress. In this work, we propose GeoWorldAD, a geometry world action model that grounds trajectory planning in ego-aligned 3D space and anticipates short-horizon scene evolution with latent future geometry tokens. Present geometry provides essential spatial constraints for safe planning, while future geometry reveals how surrounding agents and ego-centric free space may evolve, reducing overly conservative decisions without sacrificing safety. To efficiently exploit these geometric cues, GeoWorldAD progressively aggregates multi-scale present geometry and latent future geometry through iterative trajectory refinement. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 and v2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit 3D geometry grounding and future geometry world modeling for safe and efficient autonomous driving.
tldr: GeoWorldAD proposes a geometry world action model for autonomous driving that integrates explicit ego-aligned 3D geometry and latent future geometry tokens into trajectory planning, achieving state-of-the-art results on NAVSIM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GeoWorldAD 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的几何世界动作模型，将显式的自车对齐3D几何和潜在未来几何令牌融入轨迹规划，在NAVSIM基准上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 自主驾驶要求在动态三维环境中实现既安全又高效的规划决策。尽管近期的视觉/视频动作模型能够直接从视觉观测中学习策略，并随着视觉Transformer和大规模训练数据的进步而具有良好的扩展性，但它们往往缺乏明确的几何基础与未来感知的空间引导，限制了其在平衡碰撞规避与行驶进度方面的能力。本研究提出了GeoWorldAD——一种几何世界动作模型，该模型在自车对齐的三维空间中实现轨迹规划的几何基础化，并利用潜在的未来几何标记预测短时域内的场景演化。当前几何信息为安全规划提供了必要的空间约束，而未来几何则揭示了周围智能体及自车为中心的自由空间可能如何演变，从而在保障安全的前提下减少过度保守的决策。为高效利用这些几何线索，GeoWorldAD通过迭代轨迹优化逐步聚合多尺度的当前几何与潜在未来几何信息。在NAVSIM v1和v2上的实验展示了其最先进的性能，突显了显式三维几何基础与未来几何世界建模对于实现安全高效自主驾驶的有效性。

title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report
summary: Unlike conventional video game development, which relies on labor-intensive pipelines for asset production, animation, physics, and programming, video world models generate interactive environments from user inputs instantly. It enable us to create customized, explorable, and continuously evolving virtual world from text, an image, or video. Realizing this vision requires four tightly coupled capabilities: interaction, persistent spatiotemporal consistency, stable long-horizon generation, and efficient response. We present AlayaWorld, an interactive long-horizon video world model that generates 24-fps video at 540p and 720p. Built on a 15B video diffusion transformer, AlayaWorld generates short latent chunks autoregressively under camera trajectories and switchable text prompts. Its bounded visual context combines a persistent sink frame, compressed temporal history, geometry-aligned spatial memory, and recent-frame conditioning. To reduce long-term drift, the model is trained with corrupted histories and prediction residuals collected from its own roll-outs. We further introduce a discrete autoregressive distillation formulation that combines distribution-matching distillation, self-forcing++, and consistency distillation, reducing inference from approximately 30 sampling steps to four steps per chunk. On iWorld-Bench, AlayaWorld achieves the best performance over long-horizon generation. Conceived as a full-stack, open-source, and long-term project, AlayaWorld is intended to provide an extensible foundation for future research on interactive video world models.
tldr: AlayaWorld is an interactive long-horizon video world model that generates 24fps video at 540p/720p using a 15B video diffusion transformer with autoregressive latent chunks and bounded visual context to maintain spatiotemporal consistency and reduce drift.
tldr_zh: AlayaWorld 是一个交互式长时域视频世界模型，采用15B视频扩散Transformer和自回归潜变量块及有界视觉上下文，以540p/720p生成24fps视频，保持时空一致并减少漂移。
summary_zh: 与依赖劳动密集型管线进行资产制作、动画、物理模拟与编程的传统视频游戏开发不同，视频世界模型能够根据用户输入即时生成交互式环境。它使我们能够基于文本、图像或视频创建可定制、可探索且持续演化的虚拟世界。实现这一愿景需要四种紧密耦合的能力：交互性、持久时空一致性、稳定长程生成以及高效响应。我们提出AlayaWorld——一个交互式长程视频世界模型，可生成540p和720p分辨率下24帧/秒的视频。该模型基于150亿参数的视频扩散Transformer构建，能够在相机轨迹和可切换文本提示条件下自回归生成短时延潜在块。其有界视觉上下文结合了持久汇合帧、压缩时间历史、几何对齐空间记忆以及近帧条件化处理。为减少长期漂移，该模型利用从自身自回归生成过程中收集的损坏历史与预测残差进行训练。我们进一步引入离散自回归蒸馏框架，结合分布匹配蒸馏、自增强++与一致性蒸馏技术，将每个潜在块的推理从约30步采样缩减至4步。在iWorld-Bench基准测试中，AlayaWorld在长程生成任务上取得了最优性能。作为全栈开源长期项目，AlayaWorld旨在为交互式视频世界模型的未来研究提供可扩展基础。

title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
summary: Pretrained dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) are powerful yet have been underutilized in robot learning. Modern robot policies either compress each observation into a single global token, or rely on visual backbones trained from scratch, sacrificing both fine-grained spatial detail and the benefits of large-scale visual pre-training. While there exist policies that do operate on dense patch features like large vision-language-action models (VLAs), they tend to be heavy and slow, inheriting the full cost of a billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) backbone. We close this gap with Patch Policy, a minimal architectural extension that enables transformer-based policies to consume dense pre-trained patch tokens directly without the computational overhead of a full VLM. At its core is a block-causal attention mask that preserves the temporal causality of standard policies while letting the model attend over many patch tokens per observation, alongside other state information. Patch Policy is lightweight, fast, and highly effective. Across four simulated and three real-world environment suites, our method achieves a 40% relative improvement over policies using state-of-the-art global-pooled representations. Furthermore, it surpasses fine-tuned OpenVLA-OFT by 18% while using roughly 0.7% of the parameters. We believe Patch Policy provides a pipeline for the robotics community to readily leverage continuing progress in visual representation learning, without sacrificing the training efficiency or inference speed required for high-frequency, reactive control. Videos can be viewed at https://patch-policy.github.io
tldr: Patch Policy introduces a lightweight architectural extension that allows transformer-based robot policies to directly use dense pre-trained patch features from Vision Transformers, achieving significant performance gains over global pooling and large VLA models while being much faster and smaller.
tldr_zh: Patch Policy 提出了一种轻量级的架构扩展，使基于变压器的机器人策略能够直接使用来自视觉Transformer的密集预训练补丁特征，在比大型VLA模型更快、更小的同时，实现了显著的性能提升。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
Vision Transformer（ViT）预训练的密集视觉特征虽然强大，但在机器人学习中未得到充分利用。现代机器人策略要么将每个观察压缩为单个全局令牌，要么依赖从头训练的视觉骨干网络，从而牺牲了细粒度的空间细节以及大规模视觉预训练的优势。尽管存在一些采用密集补丁特征（如大型视觉-语言-动作模型，VLAs）的策略，但这些模型通常笨重且缓慢，继承了十亿级参数视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干的全部计算成本。我们通过**Patch Policy**弥补了这一差距——这是一种极简的架构扩展，使基于Transformer的策略能够直接消耗密集的预训练补丁令牌，而无需承担完整VLM的计算开销。其核心是**块因果注意力掩码**，该掩码既保留了标准策略的时间因果性，又允许模型在每步观察中关注多个补丁令牌及其他状态信息。Patch Policy轻量、快速且高效。在四个仿真环境和三个真实世界环境套件中，我们的方法相比使用最先进全局池化表示的策略实现了40%的相对性能提升。此外，它仅使用约0.7%的参数，便超越了微调后的OpenVLA-OFT模型18%。我们认为，Patch Policy为机器人领域提供了一种流水线，使其能够轻松利用视觉表征学习的持续进展，同时不牺牲高频响应控制所需的训练效率或推理速度。视频可访问 https://patch-policy.github.io 观看。

title: FM-VLA: Force-based Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models in Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive generalization in robotic manipulation, and recent memory-augmented VLAs have relaxed the Markovian assumption by conditioning on past images or language summaries. Vision-based memory approaches address this by conditioning on sampled past image frames, but they are computationally expensive and fundamentally limited when temporal events are visually ambiguous, e.g., pushing a button multiple times with small movements. We propose FM-VLA, a VLA model with force-based memory, enabling temporal context reasoning for non-Markovian, contact-rich manipulation. We encode force histories into compact force memory tokens with a variational autoencoder (VAE) pretrained with force time series reconstruction. By projecting force latent representations and short state history as additional conditioning tokens to the action expert module, we enable VLAs to leverage accumulated contact event history to guide manipulation. We evaluate FM-VLA on three memory-dependent tasks, including finding a hidden block, pressing a button, and wiping a dish for a specific number of times. Our lightweight force memory achieves over 80% success rate with minimal inference overhead, significantly outperforming baseline approaches. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/FM-VLA-Page/
tldr: FM-VLA introduces force-based memory tokens into a VLA model to enable temporal reasoning for contact-rich, non-Markovian manipulation tasks, achieving over 80% success with low overhead.
tldr_zh: FM-VLA 将基于力的记忆标记引入视觉-语言-动作模型，使其能够在接触丰富的非马尔可夫操作任务中进行时序推理，以低开销实现了超过80%的成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中已展现出显著的泛化能力，而近期引入记忆增强机制的VLA模型通过利用历史图像或语言摘要作为条件，进一步放宽了马尔可夫假设。基于视觉的记忆方法通过以采样历史图像帧作为条件来解决这一问题，但这类方法计算成本高昂，且在时间事件存在视觉模糊性时（例如通过微小动作多次按压按钮）存在根本性局限。我们提出FM-VLA模型——一种具有力觉记忆的VLA模型，能够对非马尔可夫、富含接触的操作任务进行时间上下文推理。通过预训练用于力时间序列重建的变分自编码器（VAE），我们将力历史编码为紧凑的力记忆令牌。通过将力潜在表示与短时状态历史作为附加条件令牌注入动作专家模块，我们使VLA能够利用累积的接触事件历史来引导操作。我们在三项依赖记忆的任务上评估FM-VLA，包括寻找隐藏积木、按压按钮以及按指定次数擦拭盘子。我们的轻量级力记忆模型以极低的推理开销实现了超过80%的成功率，显著优于基线方法。项目页面：https://qft-333.github.io/FM-VLA-Page/

title: Learning Adaptive Safety Margins for Visual Navigation
summary: Robots in cluttered indoor spaces often fail not because they cannot generate collision-free paths, but because a fixed safety margin is mis-calibrated: conservative margins cause detours and timeouts, while permissive margins lead to near-boundary shortcuts under perception bias. Diffusion-based planners propose diverse trajectory candidates from egocentric RGB-D, yet reliable selection remains the bottleneck. We propose a context-conditioned safety critic that learns an adaptive clearance preference for ranking diffusion proposals, decomposed into three complementary terms: (i) a safety term with a clearance-budget penalty and a control-barrier-function residual for waypoint- and transition-wise safety, (ii) an efficiency term combining a smoothness penalty with a safety-gated detour-ratio penalty that avoids detours without incentivizing risky shortcuts, and (iii) a distance-constraint matching term that anchors the learned budget to realized ESDF clearances to prevent margin collapse. We train the critic with privileged ESDF geometry in simulation and distill it into a perception-only selector via a two-stage teacher-student procedure. On PointGoal navigation in HM3D and MP3D, including cross-dataset transfer, our method achieves the highest success rate (SR) and success weighted by path length (SPL) among strong diffusion, optimization, and RL baselines. Trained purely in simulation, it transfers to a Unitree G1 humanoid and navigates cluttered indoor scenes without task-specific tuning.
tldr: This paper introduces an adaptive safety critic that learns context-dependent clearance preferences to rank trajectory proposals from diffusion-based planners, achieving superior visual navigation performance and zero-shot transfer to a humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应安全评估器，通过学习上下文相关的安全裕度偏好来排序扩散规划器生成的轨迹候选，在视觉导航中取得了更优性能，并零样本迁移到人形机器人。
summary_zh: 机器人在杂乱室内环境中失败的原因通常并非无法生成无碰撞路径，而是由于固定的安全裕度校准不当：保守的裕度导致迂回绕行和超时，而宽松的裕度则在感知偏差下引发近边界捷径行为。基于扩散的规划器能从自我中心RGB-D数据中生成多样化的轨迹候选集，但可靠的选择机制仍是瓶颈。我们提出一种上下文条件安全评判器，可学习自适应间隙偏好用于排序扩散候选轨迹，其由三个互补项构成：(i) 安全项，包含间隙预算惩罚和控制屏障函数残差，分别保障航路点级与转移级安全；(ii) 效率项，融合平滑度惩罚与安全门控绕行比惩罚，在避免迂回的同时不激励危险捷径；(iii) 距离约束匹配项，将学习到的预算与实现的环境符号距离场（ESDF）间隙锚定，防止间隙坍塌。我们在仿真中利用特权ESDF几何信息训练评判器，并通过两阶段师生蒸馏流程将其转化为纯感知选择器。在HM3D与MP3D数据集上的点目标导航任务（含跨数据集迁移）中，本方法在强扩散基线、优化基线与强化学习基线中取得了最高成功率（SR）及路径长度加权成功率（SPL）。仅经仿真训练后，该方法可直接迁移至宇树G1人形机器人，在无需任务特化调参的情况下完成杂乱室内场景导航。

title: World Translation: Minimizing Sim-to-Real Gap with Backward Dynamics Extraction and Unpaired Domain Translation
summary: The gap between simulation and reality remains a fundamental challenge in deploying simulation-trained robotic policies in the real world. Real-to-sim methods narrow this gap from the real side, learning transition dynamics from real data to build a more realistic digital world. Learned dynamics models are their dominant instance. Such methods, however, face a partial observability problem: the same observation may branch to different transitions due to unobservable factors. Existing methods assume these factors can be recovered from observation history. However, this may fail whenever observation history is uninformative, such as a sudden contact event with no prior warning. To address this limitation, we propose \textit{World Translation}, which exploits a complementary strength of simulators and learned dynamics. Simulators are deterministic but physically imperfect, while learned models are accurate but underdetermined under partial observability. Rather than predicting transitions forward from history, we extract the unobservable dynamics information backward from an observed transition, then translate this feature across simulation and reality as an unpaired domain-translation problem that preserves dynamics content while transferring domain style. Experiments across humanoid, quadruped, and manipulator platforms show that our method achieves more accurate dynamics modeling than baselines, with the largest gains when unobservable factors cannot be recovered from observation history. Real-robot deployment on Go2 quadruped confirms improved policy transfer.
tldr: This paper introduces World Translation, a method that extracts hidden dynamics information backward from observed transitions and uses unpaired domain translation to minimize the sim-to-real gap, outperforming baselines on humanoid, quadruped, and manipulator platforms as well as real-robot deployment on a Go2 quadruped.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了World Translation方法，通过逆向提取观测中的隐藏动力学信息并使用无配对域翻译来最小化仿真到现实的差距，在人形、四足和操作平台以及Go2四足机器人的实际部署中均优于基线方法。
summary_zh: 摘要：仿真与现实之间的差距，仍是将在仿真环境中训练的策略部署到现实世界时面临的根本性挑战。真实到仿真方法从真实一侧缩小这一差距，通过从真实数据中学习状态转移动力学，构建更加逼真的数字世界，其中学习型动力学模型是其主要实现形式。然而，此类方法面临部分可观测性问题：由于不可观测因素的存在，同一观测状态可能分支到不同的转移结果。现有方法假设这些因素可从观测历史中恢复，但这一假设在观测历史无信息量时会失效，例如突发接触事件毫无预警地发生。针对这一局限，我们提出“世界翻译”方法，利用仿真器与学习型动力学的互补优势：仿真器具有确定性但物理建模不完美，而学习模型虽然准确却在部分可观测条件下欠定。我们不从历史数据前向预测转移过程，而是从已观测的转移结果中反向提取不可观测的动力学信息，进而将其作为保持动力学内容并转换域风格的非配对域翻译问题，在仿真与真实环境间进行特征迁移。在仿人机器人、四足机器人和机械臂平台上的实验表明，我们的方法相较基线实现了更精准的动力学建模，尤其当不可观测因素无法从观测历史中恢复时提升最为显著。在Go2四足机器人上的真实部署验证了策略迁移效果的改善。

title: FARO: Feasibility-Aware Robot Motion Optimization
summary: Fast planning of novel behaviors in unseen scenarios remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. The high-dimensional, hybrid, and underactuated nature of humanoid loco-manipulation continues to hinder the realization of this goal. In this paper, we address this challenge by proposing a nested kino-dynamic framework for rapid feasibility checking and dynamically consistent trajectory generation given a candidate contact sequence. By integrating this module with a feasibility-guided tree search and a Large Language Model (LLM)-based contact plan sampling strategy, we demonstrate that the proposed framework can substantially improve the search process. Furthermore, we show that the generated trajectories can be tracked using a reinforcement learning (RL)-based controller and show that the resulting trajectories are of sufficiently high quality for execution in real-world loco-manipulation scenarios. A supplementary video is available at: https://youtu.be/R6qCHoCormQ.
tldr: This paper presents a nested kino-dynamic framework combined with an LLM-based contact plan sampler and feasibility-guided tree search to enable fast, dynamically consistent motion planning for humanoid loco-manipulation, with trajectories validated by an RL-based controller on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种嵌套式运动/动力学框架，结合基于大语言模型的接触规划采样与可行性引导树搜索，实现快速、动态一致的人形机器人操作与移动运动规划，并通过强化学习控制器在真实机器人上验证了轨迹质量。
summary_zh: 在未见场景中快速规划新行为仍是机器人技术领域的一项基本挑战。人形机器人全身操控具有高维、混合及欠驱动的特性，这一本质问题始终阻碍着该目标的实现。本文通过提出一种嵌套式运动动力学框架来解决这一难题，该框架能够针对候选接触序列实现快速可行性检验与动力学一致轨迹生成。通过将该模块与可行性引导的树搜索及基于大语言模型的接触规划采样策略相结合，我们证明了所提框架能显著提升搜索效率。此外，研究表明所生成的轨迹可通过基于强化学习的控制器进行跟踪，并且最终轨迹具有足够高的质量，可在真实世界的全身操控场景中执行。补充视频参见：https://youtu.be/R6qCHoCormQ。

title: MEVION: Low-Cost Open-Source Data Collection System for Powerful and High-Speed Dual-Arm Manipulation
summary: The global competition for developing robotic foundation models is intensifying. Among the data collection systems used for dual-arm robots, ALOHA is representative of being low-cost and open-source, and is widely adopted by researchers as a de facto standard. However, due to its limited ability to generate high forces and speeds, it is difficult to handle heavy objects or perform fast manipulations. To address this, we developed MEVION, a low-cost and open-source dual-arm robot data collection system capable of generating greater force and speed. All parts of this robot can be sourced through e-commerce, and by extensively utilizing sheet metal welding, its large body structure is constructed with a small number of components at low cost, while also simplifying assembly. MEVION is equipped with four 6-DoF arms with parallel grippers. Each arm weighs 7.0 kg and has a maximum torque of 60 Nm, and the entire system can be constructed for about USD 14,000. The elbow joint adopts a closed-link mechanism similar to those used in quadruped robots, which reduces the distal mass and enables higher force and speed output at the end-effector. We demonstrate that MEVION enables data collection for object manipulation tasks not previously possible and supports imitation learning-based motion generation. All hardware and software of this work are included in the Supplementary Materials or https://github.com/haraduka/mevion.
tldr: MEVION is a low-cost, open-source dual-arm robot data collection system that achieves higher force and speed than ALOHA, enabling new object manipulation tasks and supporting imitation learning.
tldr_zh: MEVION 是一个低成本、开源的双臂机器人数据采集系统，比 ALOHA 具有更高的力和速度，支持新的物体操作任务和模仿学习。
summary_zh: 全球范围内，面向机器人基础模型的研发竞争正日趋激烈。在用于双臂机器人的数据采集系统中，ALOHA以其低成本与开源特性成为代表性方案，并被研究人员广泛采用为事实标准。然而，由于该系统产生高力与高速度的能力有限，因此难以处理重物或执行快速操作。为解决这一问题，我们开发了MEVION——一种能够产生更大力与更高速度的低成本开源双臂机器人数据采集系统。该机器人的所有部件均可通过电商渠道采购，并通过大量采用钣金焊接工艺，以少量部件实现低成本构建其大型机体结构，同时简化了装配流程。MEVION配备四个具有平行夹爪的六自由度机械臂，每个机械臂重7.0千克，最大扭矩为60牛米，整个系统构建成本约为14,000美元。其肘关节采用类似四足机器人的闭链机构，可减少末端质量，并提升末端执行器的力与速度输出能力。我们证明，MEVION能够支持此前无法实现的物体操作任务数据采集，并支撑基于模仿学习的运动生成。本工作的所有硬件与软件均包含在补充材料中，或可访问 https://github.com/haraduka/mevion 获取。

title: Leveraging Two Robotic Arms for Tight Assembly Performance Gains
summary: We provide a novel end-to-end framework for the execution of an assembly operation by two robotic arms, given the digital CAD models of the parts and their desired relative placement in their assembled state. We analyze and demonstrate the advantages of using two robotic arms simultaneously in tight assembly operations, compared to single-arm systems. Our method is implemented in both simulation and using physical robots. It provides theoretical guarantees on execution time and trajectory accuracy, supported by empirical evidence. In particular, we show that coordinated movement of two arms reduces average execution time by more than 50% compared to using a single arm only, produces higher-quality trajectories, and accelerates the search for valid robot placements. Furthermore, we establish bounds on the required dimensions of the robotic cell. Our open source software together with real-life video demonstrations are available in our project page.
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end framework for dual-arm robotic assembly that leverages coordinated movement to reduce execution time by over 50% compared to single-arm systems, with theoretical guarantees and real-world validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双机械臂装配的端到端框架，通过协调运动将执行时间相比单臂系统减少50%以上，并提供了理论保证和实际验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的端到端框架，用于由两个机械臂执行装配操作，该框架基于零件的数字CAD模型及其在装配状态下所需的相对位置。我们分析并论证了在紧密装配操作中同时使用两个机械臂相较于单臂系统的优势。我们的方法已在仿真环境及实体机器人上实现。该方法在理论上对执行时间和轨迹精度提供了保障，并辅以实验证据支持。特别地，我们证明，与仅使用单臂相比，双臂协调运动可将平均执行时间减少50%以上，产生更高质量的轨迹，并加速有效机器人位姿的搜索。此外，我们确定了机器人工作单元所需尺寸的边界。我们的开源软件及真实场景视频演示已在项目页面中提供。

title: ConceptTree: Bringing Semantic Transparency to Black-Box Decision Making for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Establishing interpretable decision-making processes in long-horizon robotic manipulation is critical for enabling reliable human oversight and intervention. However, existing approaches to robotic manipulation largely treat skill selection as opaque mappings from observations to actions, offering limited transparency into how decisions are formed. In this work, we propose ConceptTree, a framework that reframes high-level manipulation skill selection as reasoning over human-interpretable concepts, representing high-level policies as a sequence of concept-level predicates over visual observations. Rather than relying on implicit latent representations, our method learns a normalized concept space grounded in visual inputs, over which a decision tree is trained to predict high-level skills. This formulation yields a transparent decision process that is both traceable and intervenable, enabling direct inspection and modification of policy behavior. We evaluate our approach on a set of real-world robotic manipulation tasks with increasing complexity. Experimental results show that ConceptTree consistently outperforms existing concept-based baselines, particularly in complex, long-horizon scenarios. Furthermore, we provide qualitative case studies showing that our model supports fine-grained intervention by modifying individual concepts, enabling targeted correction of decision errors without retraining.
tldr: ConceptTree frames high-level manipulation skill selection as reasoning over human-interpretable concepts using a decision tree trained on a normalized concept space, enabling transparent and intervenable robotic decision-making.
tldr_zh: ConceptTree 将机器人高级技能选择建模为基于可解释概念空间的决策树推理，实现了透明且可干预的决策过程。
summary_zh: 在长时域机器人操作中建立可解释的决策过程，对于实现可靠的人类监督与干预至关重要。然而，现有机器人操作方法大多将技能选择视为从观测到动作的不透明映射，决策形成过程的透明度十分有限。本研究提出ConceptTree框架，将高层操作技能选择重新定义为基于人类可理解概念的推理过程，并以视觉观测上的概念层级谓词序列来表示高层策略。该方法不依赖隐式潜在表征，而是学习一个基于视觉输入且经过归一化的概念空间，并在此空间上训练决策树以预测高层技能。这一设计产生了兼具可追溯性与可干预性的透明决策过程，能够直接检查并修改策略行为。我们在复杂度递增的真实机器人操作任务上评估了该方法，实验结果表明ConceptTree始终优于现有基于概念的基线方法，尤其在复杂长时域场景中表现突出。此外，定性案例研究显示，该模型支持通过修改单个概念实现细粒度干预，无需重新训练即可精准修正决策错误。

title: Reasoning as a Double-Edged Sword: Architecture and Cross-Stage Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Does adding a reasoning step make a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model more robust to perturbation? Intuitively, a policy that reasons before acting should absorb a perturbed input better than one that maps observations directly to actions. We test this premise head-on across three models that span the reasoning spectrum (no reasoning, a text chain-of-thought, and a latent iterative loop), perturbing each at the vision, reasoning, and action stages on LIBERO and SimplerEnv. Two questions organize the study: does the reasoning design shift robustness, and can the reasoning be read back at runtime as a safety signal? We find that the latent-iterative model is by far the least robust: under both stochastic noise and white-box perturbation its task success collapses, while the other two hold. This fragility is structural rather than cumulative: varying the reasoning depth at inference barely moves it. Reasoning outputs can in principle be monitored, but the monitors fail under fair tests. A plan--action consistency probe that looks near-perfect under naive evaluation falls to chance under adaptive attack. Under matched-FPR calibration, fusing it with an action-anomaly probe never lifts defended success above undefended. Scoped to these output-level behavioral probes under white-box vision-stage attack, this ceiling is a precondition that any viable defense must first satisfy.
tldr: This paper investigates whether reasoning in VLA models improves robustness, finding that a latent-iterative model is fragile under perturbation and that reasoning-based safety monitors fail under adaptive attacks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了VLA模型中的推理是否提升鲁棒性，发现潜在迭代模型在扰动下脆弱，且基于推理的安全监控在自适应攻击下失效。
summary_zh: 添加推理步骤是否会使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型对扰动更具鲁棒性？直观上，在行动前进行推理的决策策略应比直接将观测映射到动作的策略更能吸收扰动输入。我们针对三个覆盖不同推理程度（无推理、文本思维链、潜空间迭代循环）的模型直接验证这一假设，在LIBERO和SimplerEnv环境中分别对视觉、推理和动作阶段施加扰动。研究围绕两个问题展开：推理设计是否会改变鲁棒性？推理输出能否在运行时作为安全信号进行回读？我们发现，潜空间迭代模型的鲁棒性目前最差：在随机噪声和白盒扰动下其任务成功率崩溃，而另外两个模型保持稳定。这种脆弱性是结构性的而非累积性的：推理深度在推理时的变化几乎不影响其表现。原则上可对推理输出进行监控，但监控器在公平测试中失效。在朴素评估中近乎完美的计划-动作一致性探查在自适应攻击下降至随机水平。在匹配假阳性率校准条件下，将其与动作异常探查融合后，防御成功率从未超过无防御状态。限定于白盒视觉阶段攻击下的这些输出级行为探查，这一上限是所有可行防御方法必须首先满足的前提条件。

title: VLN-AVP: Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation with Hybrid Long-Short-Term Memory for Autonomous Valet Parking
summary: Existing methods in Autonomous Valet Parking (AVP) typically rely on pre-built maps, which severely restricts their scalability to unseen environments and open-vocabulary targets. Inspired by the application of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks, we propose VLN-AVP, a zero-shot navigation framework for AVP tasks. By combining the precise spatial perception of a Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) model with the general intelligence of VLMs, our framework 1) eliminates the dependency on pre-built maps, 2) interprets semantic environmental contexts in parking scenarios, and 3) enables intuitive navigation following natural language instructions. Specifically, we introduce a hybrid memory system: a short-term perception memory tracks semantic visual cues to address the limitations of VLM's single-frame reasoning in existing methods, while a long-term topological memory facilitates stable policy learning from past experiences. To bridge the gap in existing benchmarks, we also present the VLN-AVP dataset and benchmark. Featuring 10 high-fidelity parking scenes and over 1,000 navigation episodes, it has the largest number of garage scenes to date and is the first VLN benchmark for underground parking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that in simulation, our method achieves an over 25% improvement in success rate compared to VLN methods and an over 15% improvement compared to other autonomous driving methods. Furthermore, it attains a leading success rate in real-world vehicle experiments, proving its practical feasibility.
tldr: VLN-AVP proposes a zero-shot vision-language navigation framework for autonomous valet parking that combines a BEV model with a VLM and a hybrid long-short-term memory system, eliminating the need for pre-built maps and demonstrating improved success rates in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: VLN-AVP 提出了一种用于自动代客泊车的零样本视觉语言导航框架，结合了 BEV 模型、VLM 以及混合长短期记忆系统，消除了对预建地图的依赖，并在仿真和真实实验中展示了更高的成功率。
summary_zh: 现有自主代客泊车（AVP）方法通常依赖预建地图，这严重限制了其在未知环境与开放词汇目标下的可扩展性。受视觉-语言模型（VLM）在视觉-语言导航（VLN）任务中应用的启发，我们提出VLN-AVP——一种面向AVP任务的零样本导航框架。通过融合鸟瞰图（BEV）模型的精准空间感知能力与VLM的通用智能，该框架能够：1）消除对预建地图的依赖，2）解析停车场场景中的语义环境信息，3）实现遵循自然语言指令的直观导航。具体而言，我们引入混合记忆系统：短期感知记忆追踪语义视觉线索，以弥补现有方法中VLM单帧推理的局限性；长期拓扑记忆则支持从过往经验中学习稳定的策略。为填补现有基准的空白，我们还提出了VLN-AVP数据集与基准。该数据集包含10个高保真停车场场景与超过1000个导航片段，拥有迄今最大规模的停车场场景数量，并是首个面向地下停车场的VLN基准。大量实验表明，在仿真环境中，我们的方法相较VLN方法成功率提升超25%，相较其他自动驾驶方法成功率提升超15%。此外，该方法在真实车辆实验中取得了领先的成功率，验证了其实用可行性。

title: HCPG-Flow:Hierarchical Contact-Progress Guidance for Flow-Policy Robot Manipulation
summary: Flow policies can represent multimodal action distributions for robot manipulation, yet a robot must execute one action at each control step. When several proposals are sampled, critic-based ranking makes data collection depend on value estimates over candidate actions that may be weakly represented in replay. We introduce HCPG-Flow, an analytic rollout-time selector that augments SAC-Flow with hierarchical, object-centric contact-progress guidance while preserving its actor and critic objectives. HCPG switches from end-effector approach to task progress after contact, scores each proposal by the first-order reduction of a task-relevant distance, standardizes scores within the candidate set, and executes a temperature-controlled action embedding. Across ten simulated tasks, HCPG improves mean success over SAC-Flow on both benchmarks, including a 9.5 percentage-point gain on Maniskill. Four physical tasks further show high success with a 17.4% reduction in successful completion steps.Project page: https://hitxraz.github.io/HCPG-Flow/
tldr: HCPG-Flow introduces an analytic rollout-time selector with hierarchical contact-progress guidance to improve action selection in flow-based robot manipulation policies, achieving higher success rates and fewer steps on simulated and real tasks.
tldr_zh: HCPG-Flow 提出了一种分析式的 rollout 时间选择器，结合分层接触-进度引导来改进基于流的机器人操作策略中的动作选择，在模拟和真实任务中实现了更高的成功率和更少的执行步骤。
summary_zh: 流策略可以表征机器人操作中的多模态动作分布，但机器人必须在每个控制步长执行一个动作。当采样多个候选方案时，基于评判器的排序使数据收集依赖于对候选动作的价值估计，而这些动作在经验回放中可能表征不足。我们提出HCPG-Flow——一种分析式部署期选择器，在保留原行动者-评判器目标函数的基础上，通过引入层级化、以物体为中心的接触进程引导机制来增强SAC-Flow。HCPG在接触发生后将末端执行器引导策略切换为任务进程引导策略，通过任务相关距离的一阶缩减对每个候选方案进行评分，在候选集内对分数进行标准化处理，并执行温度控制型动作嵌入。在十个模拟任务中，HCPG在两个基准测试集上的平均成功率均优于SAC-Flow，其中在Maniskill基准上提升9.5个百分点。四项实体任务进一步展现了高成功率，且成功完成步数减少17.4%。项目页面：https://hitxraz.github.io/HCPG-Flow/

title: Predictive Training with Latent Imagination for Visual Quadruped Navigation
summary: Reinforcement-learning navigation policies for legged robots select actions reactively from current observations and short-term memory, with limited capacity to anticipate how moving obstacles will evolve in the near future. In dynamic environments, this reactivity causes the robot to respond too late because collision risk depends on short-horizon scene structure rather than on current obstacle positions alone. Lightweight predictive supervision applied to the policy's recurrent state during training can encode anticipatory obstacle dynamics without modifying the inference-time controller. We augment a reactive LSTM-SRU navigation backbone with an auxiliary JEPA-style predictor and SIGReg regularization: during training, the predictor supervises the deterministic hidden state to anticipate its own next state; at inference, it is fully discarded, incurring zero additional computational cost. On simulated and real-world navigation benchmarks with dynamic obstacles, our method substantially improves navigation success while reducing collision rates through the predictive training signal alone, without additional inference-time parameters. Real-robot deployment on a Unitree Go2 demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer: the controller navigates cluttered indoor and dynamic outdoor environments without fine-tuning, with evasive behavior consistent with the collision reduction observed in simulation.
tldr: This paper proposes a lightweight predictive training method that augments a reactive LSTM-SRU navigation backbone for legged robots with an auxiliary JEPA-style predictor and SIGReg regularization, enabling the policy's recurrent state to encode anticipatory obstacle dynamics during training without any additional computation at inference, leading to improved navigation success and reduced collision rates in both simulation and real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种轻量级预测训练方法，通过在反应式 LSTM-SRU 导航骨干网络上添加辅助 JEPA 式预测器和 SIGReg 正则化，在训练阶段让策略的循环状态编码对障碍物动态的预期，而在推理时不增加任何额外计算，从而在仿真和 Unitree Go2 真实机器人上提升导航成功率并降低碰撞率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
针对腿式机器人设计的强化学习导航策略，通过当前观测和短期记忆反应式选择动作，其预测移动障碍物近期演变的能力有限。在动态环境中，由于碰撞风险取决于短时域场景结构而非当前障碍物位置，这种反应性会导致机器人响应滞后。通过在训练期间对策略的循环状态施加轻量级预测监督，可在不修改推理阶段控制器的情况下编码障碍物动态的预期特征。我们为反应式LSTM-SRU导航主干网络补充了辅助式JEPA预测器与SIGReg正则化：训练时，预测器监督确定性隐状态以预估其下一时刻状态；推理时则完全舍弃该预测器，不产生额外计算开销。在含动态障碍物的仿真与现实导航基准测试中，仅通过预测性训练信号即可显著提升导航成功率并降低碰撞率，无需增加推理阶段的参数。在Unitree Go2上的实际机器人部署验证了零样本仿真到现实的迁移能力：该控制器无需微调即可在杂乱室内与动态户外环境中导航，其规避行为与仿真中观察到的碰撞率降低表现一致。

title: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
summary: Test-time scaling improves foundation-model inference by spending additional computation, but robot control requires deciding whether extra compute is useful before executing an action. World Action Models (WAMs) make this decision natural: each rollout exposes both an action chunk and predicted future observations. We propose \methodgated, a training-free selective test-time scaling framework for WAMs. We first instantiate \method, a fixed-budget Best-of-$N$ selector that ranks sampled rollouts by cross-view depth reprojection consistency of their predicted futures, computed with a frozen geometry foundation model. \methodgated\ adds a lightweight action--future consistency gate that invokes \method\ only when the initial rollout appears internally inconsistent. Across five benchmark--backbone settings on RoboCasa, LIBERO Long, and RoboTwin~2.0, fixed-budget \method\ improves $N{=}8$ task success in every setting, e.g., raising the RoboCasa group average from $66.3\%$ to $68.4\%$ with Cosmos Policy and from $80.8\%$ to $82.5\%$ with X-WAM. With gating enabled, \methodgated\ recovers on average $74.8\%$ of the always-on success gain while triggering additional sampling on only $26.2\%$ of decision points. Offline diagnostics show that cross-view reprojection is a strong task-label-free selector, and we identify false low-score selections as a failure mode that helps explain why performance can saturate or degrade as $N$ increases.
tldr: The paper proposes a training-free test-time scaling method for World Action Models that selects rollouts via cross-view depth reprojection consistency, improving task success with minimal computational overhead.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的测试时扩展方法，通过跨视角深度重投影一致性来筛选世界行动模型的预测结果，在最小化计算开销的同时提升了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 测试时扩展通过增加额外计算来提升基础模型的推理能力，但机器人控制需要在执行动作前判断额外计算是否有效。世界动作模型（WAMs）使这一决策变得自然：每次 rollout 能同时产生动作片段和预测的未来观测值。我们提出 \methodgated——一种面向 WAMs 的免训练选择性测试时扩展框架。首先实例化 \method，一种固定预算的 Best-of-$N$ 选择器，通过冻结的几何基础模型计算预测未来的跨视图深度重投影一致性，对采样的 rollout 进行排序。\methodgated 增加了轻量级的动作-未来一致性门控，仅当初始 rollout 出现内部不一致时才调用 \method。在 RoboCasa、LIBERO Long 和 RoboTwin~2.0 的五个基准-主干设置中，固定预算的 \method 在所有设置下均提升了 $N{=}8$ 的任务成功率，例如将 RoboCasa 组平均成功率从 $66.3\%$ 提升至 $68.4\%$（使用 Cosmos Policy）以及从 $80.8\%$ 提升至 $82.5\%$（使用 X-WAM）。启用门控后，\methodgated 平均恢复了 $74.8\%$ 的持续扩展成功率增益，同时仅在 $26.2\%$ 的决策点上触发额外采样。离线诊断表明，跨视图重投影是一种有效的无任务标签选择器，我们识别出假低分选择这一失效模式，有助于解释为何随着 $N$ 增加性能可能饱和或下降。

title: Anticipate Before Acting: Future-State-Conditioned Vision-Language Navigation
summary:
End-to-end vision-language navigation (VLN) with causal vision-language models can map instructions and egocentric observations directly to actions, but standard behavior cloning supervises only the next action and does not explicitly train the policy state to be predictive of future visual outcomes. We first ask a diagnostic question: if the policy is given an expert-trajectory future image as privileged input at training and testing time, is that additional visual evidence useful for choosing the current action? (These expert-trajectory future images are unavailable at test time in real deployment, so we use this setting only as a privileged-input diagnostic.) The answer is yes; this sanity check shows that future observations can provide rich, actionable cues.
  We then ask a deployable question: without accessing future images at inference, can we still benefit from future information by using a compressed future visual latent only as training supervision? We propose Future-State-Conditioned VLN (FSC-VLN), which adds a future-query token and aligns its hidden state to a frozen visual embedding $Δ$ steps ahead via a training-only target branch that is removed after training. On R2R val-unseen, FSC-VLN improves SR/OSR/SPL over a StreamVLN-style baseline under two training-data regimes, with larger gains on long-horizon episodes; ablations further support the dual-query design (separating future and action queries).
tldr: This paper proposes Future-State-Conditioned VLN (FSC-VLN), a method that improves vision-language navigation by training a policy to align its hidden state with a future visual representation, without requiring future images at test time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出未来状态条件视觉语言导航（FSC-VLN），通过训练策略在隐状态中编码未来视觉表示来提升导航性能，且推理时不需未来图像。
summary_zh:
端到端视觉-语言导航（VLN）结合因果视觉-语言模型可直接将指令与自我中心观测映射至动作，但标准行为克隆仅监督下一个动作，并未明确训练策略状态以预测未来视觉结果。我们首先提出一个诊断性问题：若在训练和测试时将专家轨迹的未来图像作为特权输入提供给策略，该额外视觉证据是否有助于当前动作的选择？（在真实部署的测试阶段无法获取这些专家轨迹的未来图像，因此我们仅将该设定用作特权输入诊断。）答案是肯定的；这一合理性检验表明，未来观测能够提供丰富且可操作的线索。
随后我们提出一个可部署问题：在推理时无需访问未来图像的情况下，是否仍能通过仅将压缩的未来视觉隐变量作为训练监督来利用未来信息？我们提出基于未来状态条件的VLN方法（FSC-VLN），该方法新增一个未来查询令牌，并通过仅在训练阶段使用的目标分支（训练后移除）将其隐状态与前方Δ步的冻结视觉嵌入对齐。在R2R验证集未见环境下，FSC-VLN在两种训练数据模式下均比StreamVLN风格基线提升了SR/OSR/SPL指标，且在长轨迹任务中收益更大；消融实验进一步支持了双查询设计（分离未来查询与动作查询）。

title: SAGE: Subgoal-Conditioned Action Generation for Latent World Model Planning
summary: Latent world models have emerged as a powerful planning paradigm by learning action-conditioned predictive dynamics and using them as internal simulators to imagine and evaluate candidate action sequences. However, as the planning horizon grows, performance becomes increasingly constrained by proposal quality: a fixed candidate budget must search an exponentially larger action space, making it difficult to expose the world model to high-quality candidate futures for evaluation. In this paper, we introduce a prior-conditioned planner that replaces random proposal initialization with structured guidance. At each planning stage, a goal-conditioned generator predicts the next reachable latent subgoal for a specified duration, which is then used to condition the generation of candidate action sequences. To capture semantic information across temporal scales, we use subgoals of varying durations as priors, balancing fine-grained local control with higher-level long-horizon progress. Then the frozen world model evaluates and refines these subgoal-conditioned proposals before execution. Experiments on PushT and OGBench Cube show that coupling latent subgoal decomposition with prior-conditioned action generation substantially improves long-horizon planning while preserving strong short-horizon performance. To be specific, when the target offset is $150$, it raises PushT success from $12.7\%$ to $64.7\%$ and OGBench Cube success from $26.7\%$ to $67.3\%$.
tldr: This paper proposes a prior-conditioned planner that uses a goal-conditioned generator to produce latent subgoals, which then guide the generation of candidate action sequences for latent world model planning, significantly improving long-horizon control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种先验条件规划器，通过目标条件生成器产生潜在子目标，进而指导候选动作序列的生成，显著提升了潜在世界模型的长时域规划性能。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过学习基于动作的条件预测动力学，并将其作为内部模拟器来想象和评估候选动作序列，已成为一种强大的规划范式。然而，随着规划时间跨度的增长，性能越来越受到提案质量的制约：固定的候选预算需要在呈指数级增长的动作空间中进行搜索，这使得世界模型难以获得高质量的候选未来状态用于评估。本文提出了一种先验条件规划器，用结构化引导替代随机提案初始化。在每个规划阶段，一个目标条件生成器预测指定时间范围内下一个可达的潜在子目标，并以此为基础生成候选动作序列。为捕捉跨时间尺度的语义信息，我们采用不同时间跨度的子目标作为先验，从而在细粒度的局部控制与高层级的长远进程之间取得平衡。随后，冻结的世界模型在执行前对这些子目标条件提案进行评估与优化。在PushT和OGBench Cube上的实验表明，将潜在子目标分解与先验条件动作生成相结合，能显著提升长时域规划性能，同时保持优异的短时域表现。具体而言，当目标偏移量为150时，PushT任务的成功率从12.7%提升至64.7%，OGBench Cube任务的成功率从26.7%提升至67.3%。

title: VGOcc: Learning Visual-Geometric Gaussians for Vision-Centric 3D Driving Occupancy Prediction
summary: Vision-only occupancy prediction requires recovering a semantic 3D occupancy field from calibrated surround-view images, where each view provides observations with ambiguous depth along camera rays. Existing methods have progressed from dense structured representations to sparse Gaussian primitives, improving the efficiency of 3D scene representation. However, Gaussian learning still relies primarily on image domain features, which provide limited explicit geometric information for volumetric reasoning. Our key observation is that effective Gaussian occupancy modeling requires not only sparse primitives, but also richer geometric and semantic learning cues. In this paper, we propose VGOcc, which learns visual and geometric cues from foundation models for Gaussian modeling. VGOcc incorporates these cues into primitive initialization and refinement, yielding a representation termed Visual-Geometric Gaussians tailored to semantic occupancy prediction. Specifically, we propose Visual-Geometric Gaussian Birth to form spatially balanced Gaussian centers from ray depth hypotheses, while visual semantic features initialize primitive attributes. Next, we design Pose-Aware Feature Learning to combine foundation tokens with camera embeddings and calibrated ray information. Features from neighboring views are then aggregated at projected 3D locations for each Gaussian refinement stage. Finally, Gaussian decoder refines birth Gaussians with pose-aware features and renders them into semantic occupancy. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate that VGOcc achieves state-of-the-art performance in vision-only 3D occupancy prediction. Codes will be available at https://github.com/JHLin42in/VGOcc.
tldr: VGOcc introduces Visual-Geometric Gaussians for vision-only 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, leveraging foundation models to provide richer geometric and semantic cues for Gaussian-based scene representation and achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
tldr_zh: VGOcc 将视觉-几何高斯引入仅基于视觉的3D占据预测，利用基础模型提供更丰富的几何和语义线索进行高斯场景表示，在 nuScenes 上达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 纯视觉占据预测要求从标定的环视图像中恢复语义三维占据场，而每个视角沿相机射线提供的观测深度存在模糊性。现有方法已从稠密结构化表示发展为稀疏高斯基元，提升了三维场景表示的效率。然而，高斯学习仍主要依赖图像域特征，这类特征为体积推理提供的显式几何信息有限。我们的关键发现是：有效的高斯占据建模不仅需要稀疏基元，更需要更丰富的几何与语义学习线索。本文提出VGOcc方法，从基础模型中学习视觉与几何线索用于高斯建模。VGOcc将这些线索融入基元初始化和细化过程，形成专为语义占据预测设计的视觉-几何高斯表示。具体而言，我们提出视觉-几何高斯生成机制，基于射线深度假设构建空间平衡的高斯中心，同时利用视觉语义特征初始化基元属性。接着设计位姿感知特征学习模块，将基础模型令牌与相机嵌入及标定射线信息结合，并在每个高斯细化阶段的投影三维位置处聚合邻域视角特征。最后，高斯解码器利用位姿感知特征优化生成的高斯基元，并将其渲染为语义占据场。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，VGOcc在纯视觉三维占据预测中达到了最优性能。代码将开源至 https://github.com/JHLin42in/VGOcc。

title: Optimization of sim-to-real transfer in the humanoid robot NICO
summary: Robotic grasping requires accurate coordination between visual perception, object localization, inverse kinematics, and hand control. However, when movements planned in simulation are executed on a physical robot, the sim-to-real gap can cause small positioning errors that prevent successful grasping. In our previous work, we introduced a low-cost haptic calibration method that improved 2D reaching accuracy of the humanoid robot NICO. In this paper, we extend this approach from reaching to tabletop object grasping by adding YOLO-based object and hand detection, stereo vision-based localization using the robot's built-in low-resolution fisheye cameras, and task-specific corrections for grasp execution. Together, these components form a novel calibration-based grasping pipeline that does not require RGB-D cameras, motion capture, or external tracking systems. We also implemented a visual feedback model that aligns the robot hand with the detected object before grasping. Our results show that the fully nonlinear calibration model achieved the best performance inside the calibrated area, while the visual feedback model achieved the highest overall grasping success across the full tabletop workspace.
tldr: This paper extends a haptic calibration method from reaching to tabletop grasping on the NICO humanoid robot, using YOLO-based detection and stereo vision to reduce sim-to-real errors without external tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文将对NICO人形机器人上的触觉校准方法从伸展动作扩展到桌面抓取，利用YOLO检测和立体视觉减少仿真到现实的误差，且无需外部追踪系统。
summary_zh: 机器人抓取需要视觉感知、目标定位、逆运动学与手部控制之间的精确协调。然而，当在仿真中规划的运动被部署至实体机器人执行时，仿真与现实的差异会导致细微定位误差，从而阻碍成功抓取。在先前工作中，我们提出了一种低成本触觉标定方法，有效提升了仿人机器人NICO的二维到达精度。本文将该方法从到达任务扩展至桌面物体抓取，具体改进包括：引入基于YOLO的物体与手部检测、利用机器人内置低分辨率鱼眼摄像头实现立体视觉定位，以及针对抓取执行的任务特定校正。这些模块共同构成了一套新型的基于标定的抓取流程，该流程无需RGB-D摄像头、动作捕捉系统或外部追踪装置。我们还实现了一种视觉反馈模型，使机器人在抓取前将手部与检测到的物体对齐。结果表明，全非线性标定模型在标定区域内性能最优，而视觉反馈模型在整个桌面工作空间中实现了最高的总体抓取成功率。

title: Towards Torque-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for legged robots is advancing locomotion, demonstrating its ability to adapt to new and challenging terrain. Traditionally, these RL locomotion frameworks are position-based, making the policy less adaptable to terrain types and requiring state estimation techniques in the observation space, i.e., linear velocity. Moreover, these RL frameworks often use small, lightweight quadrupeds that are limited in their viability for high-complexity tasks due to hardware constraints. This work explores an RL torque control framework for heavyweight high-torque quadrupeds. The RL framework in this paper can traverse rough terrain and effectively track a desired linear velocity without requiring knowledge of the agent's current velocity. Using Nvidia's Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, simulation results of the RL torque control policy are shown on the Unitree B1 quadruped, achieving speeds of 3.5 m/s and 1.5 rad/s. In addition, the quadruped can walk up and down stairs without the aid of an exteroceptive sensor.
tldr: This paper presents a torque-driven reinforcement learning framework for heavyweight quadrupeds, enabling traversal of rough terrain and velocity tracking without velocity state estimation or exteroceptive sensors, demonstrated in simulation on the Unitree B1 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向重型四足机器人的扭矩驱动强化学习框架，无需速度状态估计或外部传感器即可实现崎岖地形穿越和速度跟踪，并在Unitree B1机器人的仿真中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 基于强化学习的足式机器人运动控制技术正在不断进步，展现出适应复杂新地形的能力。传统强化学习运动框架多采用基于位置的控制模式，导致策略对不同地形类型的适应能力较弱，且需要在观测空间中引入状态估计技术（如线速度估计）。此外，现有框架通常使用轻量级小型四足机器人，由于硬件限制难以胜任高复杂度任务。本文探索了一种适用于重型高扭矩四足机器人的强化学习力矩控制框架。该框架无需获取智能体当前速度信息，即可穿越崎岖地形并有效跟踪期望线速度。通过英伟达Isaac Sim与Isaac Lab仿真平台，验证了该强化学习力矩控制策略在宇树B1四足机器人上的性能，可实现3.5米/秒的线速度和1.5弧度/秒的角速度。更值得关注的是，该四足机器人无需借助外部传感器即可自主上下楼梯。

title: Isaac Sim-to-Real: Reinforcement Learning based Locomotion for Quadrupeds
summary: Learning-based approaches to locomotion have risen in popularity in recent years, showing the capability for complex legged locomotion and whole-body control. Reinforcement learning (RL), the primary learning-based approach for locomotion, often utilizes a high-performance simulation tool, providing a controlled and efficient training and development environment. However, policies that perform well in simulation frequently encounter unexpected challenges when deployed on a physical system, known as the sim-to-real gap. This work presents a robust RL locomotion framework capable of whole-body control. The proposed RL framework utilizes Nvidia's new set of simulation tools, Isaac Sim, and its companion RL framework, Isaac Lab, for training, achieving a zero-shot sim-to-real policy. The performance of our policy is validated on physical hardware using the Unitree Go1, with experimental results showing similar velocity tracking performance to the quadruped's integrated controller, with a greater ability to recover from large disturbances, and achieve linear velocities of 2.0 m/s and angular velocities of 1.8 rad/s.
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework using Nvidia's Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab to train a quadruped locomotion policy that achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on the Unitree Go1, demonstrating robust whole-body control and recovery from disturbances.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用Nvidia Isaac Sim和Isaac Lab的强化学习框架，训练四足机器人运动策略，实现在Unitree Go1上的零样本仿真到现实迁移，展示了鲁棒的全向控制与扰动恢复能力。
summary_zh: 基于学习的运动控制在近年来日益普及，展现出在复杂腿式运动与全身控制方面的能力。作为运动控制领域主要的基于学习方法，强化学习常利用高性能仿真工具，提供受控且高效的训练与开发环境。然而，在仿真中表现良好的策略部署到物理系统时，常会遇到意料之外的挑战，即"仿真到现实"的差距。本项工作提出了一种能够实现全身控制的鲁棒强化学习运动框架。该框架利用英伟达新一代仿真工具Isaac Sim及其配套强化学习框架Isaac Lab进行训练，实现了零样本的仿真到现实策略迁移。我们采用Unitree Go1四足机器人对策略性能进行了物理硬件验证，实验结果显示：该策略的速度跟踪性能与四足机器人集成控制器相当，但具备更强的抵抗大扰动恢复能力，可实现2.0米/秒的线速度和1.8弧度/秒的角速度。

title: Importance Sampling and PCA for Finding Failures in Commercial Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Methods for discovering rare failures in autonomous systems have so far been demonstrated almost exclusively in simulations with simple, academic driving stacks, leaving open whether they generalize to the more robust planners used in commercial systems. We address this gap by applying two rare-event discovery algorithms to a commercial autonomous trucking stack. Adaptive stress testing (AST) uses reinforcement learning to search for the most likely noise trajectories leading to a simulated collision, while diffusion-based failure sampling (DiFS) trains a denoising diffusion model to sample a diverse set of failures. We show that both algorithms find simulated collisions during merge and cut-in maneuvers where traditional Monte Carlo simulation does not. To make these failures actionable, we introduce a statistical analysis based on principal component analysis (PCA) that classifies failures into common modes and identifies the timesteps that most influence the outcome. We cluster the principal components and invert the PCA transform to recover generalized noise trajectories, and show that these trajectories reproduce failures in identical and similar scenarios. This provides a path from failure discovery to systematic diagnosis of perception-level flaws.
tldr: Applies AST and DiFS to a commercial autonomous trucking stack to discover rare collisions, and introduces PCA-based analysis to classify failure modes and recover generalized noise trajectories.
tldr_zh: 将AST和DiFS应用于商业自动驾驶卡车系统以发现罕见碰撞，并引入基于PCA的分析来分类故障模式并恢复通用噪声轨迹。
summary_zh: 目前在自主系统中发现罕见故障的方法，几乎全部仅通过使用简单的学术驾驶堆栈进行仿真验证，尚未验证这些方法是否能泛化至商业系统中更加鲁棒的规划器。为填补这一空白，我们将两种罕见事件发现算法应用于商用自动驾驶卡车堆栈。自适应压力测试（AST）利用强化学习搜索最有可能导致模拟碰撞的噪声轨迹，而基于扩散的故障采样（DiFS）则训练去噪扩散模型以采样多样化的故障集合。我们证明，在传统蒙特卡洛模拟无法发现的并道与切入操作中，这两种算法均能发现模拟碰撞。为使这些故障具备可操作性，我们引入基于主成分分析（PCA）的统计方法，将故障分类为常见模式，并识别对结果影响最大的时间步。我们对主成分进行聚类，并通过逆PCA变换恢复泛化的噪声轨迹，进而证明这些轨迹能够在相同及相似场景中复现故障。这为从故障发现到感知层面缺陷的系统性诊断提供了可行路径。

title: Distilling Global Traversability Priors for Image-based Affordance Prediction in Off-road Environments
summary: Standard methods for autonomous navigation in unstructured terrain are prone to myopic behaviors in long-horizon scenarios. The use of metric maps built from LiDAR or cameras provides necessary local geometry and semantic information but is strictly limited by depth sensing range. By discarding data beyond the mapping horizon robots suffer from suboptimal, short-sighted decisions. To recover this lost information, we focus on extracting long-range traversability-aware frontiers directly from first-person-view (FPV) images. By leveraging satellite imagery, we compute the set of feasible navigation paths for a dataset of image/pose pairs and use them to supervise our network, reducing the need for extensive human demonstration data. We demonstrate that this approach improves performance in long-range off-road navigation over existing methods by more than 10% in various offline benchmarks and reduces the number of human interventions incurred in a set of real-world experiments. More details can be found at https://theairlab.org/ss_frontiers_iros .
tldr: This paper introduces a method to distill global traversability priors from satellite imagery into a network that predicts long-range affordance from first-person-view images, improving long-horizon off-road navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，从卫星图像中提取全局可通行先验，并将其蒸馏到网络中，用于从第一人称视角图像预测远距离的可通行属性，从而提升越野导航的长期规划能力。
summary_zh: 在非结构化地形中进行自主导航的标准方法在长距离场景中容易产生短视行为。利用激光雷达或相机建立的度量地图虽能提供必要的局部几何与语义信息，但严格受限于深度感知范围。因丢弃超出建图范围的数据，机器人会做出次优的短视决策。为恢复这部分丢失的信息，我们聚焦于直接从第一人称视角（FPV）图像中提取具有远距离可通行性感知的前沿区域。通过利用卫星图像，我们为一组图像/位姿对计算出可行的导航路径集合，并以此监督网络训练，从而减少对大量人工演示数据的需求。实验证明，该方法在多种离线基准测试中，相较于现有方法将远程越野导航性能提升了超过10%，并在实际场景实验中减少了人工干预次数。更多详情请访问 https://theairlab.org/ss_frontiers_iros。

title: Manifold-Guided Motion Planning for Tight Assemblies
summary: Motion planning for rigid-body assembly poses a fundamental challenge in robotics due to tight geometric constraints. In such scenarios, feasible motions often require passing through (near-)zero clearance configurations in which the parts are tightly constrained by contact. In this work, we introduce Critical-Manifold Guided RRT (CMG-RRT), a sampling-based planner designed specifically for tight assembly problems. Our key observation is that in tight assemblies, valid solution paths lie on or near a critical manifold: the subset of configuration space consisting of poses with at least one contact point between parts. CMG-RRT guides exploration by adaptively biasing sampling toward neighborhoods of the critical manifold using a hierarchical subdivision of the configuration space. We prove that CMG-RRT is probabilistically complete under standard clearance assumptions. Empirical evaluation on challenging rotational assembly benchmarks demonstrates a 100% success rate across all tested instances, including, to the best of our knowledge, the first fully automatic solution of the Elk disentanglement puzzle. Our open source software is available through our project page: https://www.cgl.cs.tau.ac.il/projects/tight-assembly-planning.
tldr: This paper introduces CMG-RRT, a sampling-based motion planner that biases exploration toward the critical manifold of contact configurations, achieving 100% success on challenging tight assembly benchmarks including the first fully automatic solution of the Elk disentanglement puzzle.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 CMG-RRT，一种基于采样的运动规划器，通过自适应地将采样偏向接触配置的临界流形，在紧装配基准测试中实现了 100% 的成功率，包括首次完全自动解决 Elk 解谜难题。
summary_zh: 刚体装配的运动规划由于存在严格的几何约束，对机器人技术构成了根本性挑战。在此类场景中，可行运动通常需要穿过（接近）零间隙的构型，即零件因接触而受到紧密约束。本文提出临界流形引导的RRT（CMG-RRT），这是一种专门针对紧密装配问题设计的基于采样的规划器。我们的关键发现是：在紧密装配中，有效解路径位于或靠近临界流形——即由零件间存在至少一个接触点的构型组成的构型空间子集。CMG-RRT通过利用构型空间的层次化细分，自适应地将采样偏向于临界流形邻域，从而引导探索过程。我们证明了在标准间隙假设下CMG-RRT具有概率完备性。在具有挑战性的旋转装配基准测试上的实证评估表明，所有测试实例均实现了100%的成功率，其中包括（据我们所知）首次全自动求解的麋鹿解谜难题。我们开源软件的获取方式见项目页面：https://www.cgl.cs.tau.ac.il/projects/tight-assembly-planning。

title: Receiver-Centered Robot-to-Human Handover with Grasp-Aware Object Orientation
summary: Collaborative robots are increasingly sharing workspaces with human operators, making tool handover a frequent and safety-critical micro-interaction. However, traditional static handovers often lead to awkward grasps when handling asymmetric industrial tools. This paper presents a receiver-centered voice-driven adaptive handover system for mechanical tools, built on a Franka cobot. Using an LLM for intention recognition and MediaPipe for real-time 3D hand tracking, the framework dynamically adjusts the end-effector's orientation to present tools in an ergonomically optimal, handle-first pose. A within-subjects study compared this adaptive approach with an object-agnostic static baseline. The results demonstrate that the adaptive system reduces the grasp delay for asymmetric tools, improving the fluency of the interaction. Furthermore, the adaptive strategy improved specific trust-related perceptions, particularly motion predictability and perceived task simplicity.
tldr: This paper presents a receiver-centered, voice-driven adaptive handover system for human-robot tool handover, using an LLM for intention recognition and real-time hand tracking to dynamically adjust tool orientation, and shows improved grasp delay and trust perceptions compared to a static baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种以接收者为中心的、由语音驱动的自适应人机工具交接系统，利用LLM进行意图识别和实时手部跟踪来动态调整工具朝向，实验表明相比静态基线，该方法改善了抓取延迟并提升了信任感知。
summary_zh: 协作机器人越来越多地与人类操作员共享工作空间，这使得工具交接成为一种频繁且关乎安全的关键微交互过程。然而，在处理非对称工业工具时，传统的静态交接方式往往会导致笨拙的抓取动作。本文提出了一种基于接收者中心、由语音驱动的机械工具自适应交接系统，该系统以Franka协作机器人为平台。该框架利用大语言模型进行意图识别，并借助MediaPipe实现实时三维手部追踪，能够动态调整末端执行器的姿态，以符合人体工学的优化方式将工具以手柄朝前的姿势呈现。一项被试内研究将这种自适应方法与忽略物体特征的静态基线方法进行了对比。结果表明，自适应系统减少了非对称工具的抓取延迟，提升了交互的流畅性。此外，自适应策略还改善了用户对特定信任维度的感知，尤其是运动可预测性和感知任务简易性。

title: A2RL V\textsubscript{max}: The A2RL autonomous racing dataset for long-range, high-speed perception and multi-vehicle interaction
summary: In autonomous driving development, a perception dataset is crucial, as it provides fundamental data for training, testing, and validating algorithms for an autonomous vehicle's multimodal perception systems. So far, most research has concentrated on providing datasets for well-structured urban environments. This work introduces the A2RL V\textsubscript{max} open-source dataset, specifically designed for perception tasks in high-speed autonomous driving and multi-vehicle interaction. The dataset was captured during the 2024 Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL), held at the Yas Marina F1 Circuit, with participation from all competing teams. It contains diverse scenarios, including single-vehicle data at varying speeds, multi-vehicle sessions, and the full final four-vehicle race. The dataset contains almost 30,000 professionally annotated LiDAR point clouds, along with RADAR point clouds. In particular, it is the first large-scale dataset in autonomous racing to feature professionally annotated LiDAR point clouds, enabling deep learning-based perception research. The data is provided in a developer-friendly format, enabling easy implementation and evaluation in future research. We provide implementation and evaluation for off-the-shelf 3D detection and tracking methods. Although baseline methods show promising results for both 3D detection and tracking, specialized methods are required to address the unique challenges of high-speed autonomous driving. For a detailed description of the dataset, please visit the \href{https://tum-avs.github.io/A2RL_Dataset_website/}{A2RL V\textsubscript{max} Dataset Website}
tldr: This paper introduces A2RL Vmax, a large-scale dataset for high-speed autonomous racing perception, featuring professionally annotated LiDAR and RADAR point clouds from the 2024 Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 A2RL Vmax，一个专为高速自动驾驶赛车感知设计的大规模数据集，包含来自2024年阿布扎比自动驾驶赛车联赛的专业标注激光雷达和雷达点云。
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶技术研发中，感知数据集至关重要，它为自动驾驶车辆多模态感知系统的训练、测试与算法验证提供基础数据。迄今为止，多数研究集中于结构化城市环境的数据集构建。本研究推出A2RL V\textsubscript{max}开源数据集，专门针对高速自动驾驶与多车交互场景中的感知任务设计。该数据集于2024年阿布扎比自动驾驶赛车联赛（A2RL）期间采集，比赛在亚斯码头F1赛道举行，所有参赛车队均参与数据采集。数据集包含丰富场景，涵盖不同速度下的单车数据、多车行驶阶段，以及完整的四车决赛过程。该数据集包含近30,000个经专业标注的激光雷达点云及雷达点云数据。特别值得关注的是，这是自动驾驶赛车领域首个大规模专业标注激光雷达点云数据集，为基于深度学习的感知研究提供了可能。数据以开发者友好格式提供，便于在后续研究中直接部署与评估。我们针对现有3D检测与追踪方法给出了实现方案与性能评估。尽管基线方法在3D检测与追踪方面展现出良好潜力，但应对高速自动驾驶特有挑战仍需专门化方法。关于数据集的详细描述，请访问\href{https://tum-avs.github.io/A2RL_Dataset_website/}{A2RL V\textsubscript{max}数据集官网}。

title: From Sign Language Generation to Humanoid Execution: Vision-Language Guided Retargeting with Collision Mitigation
summary: Recent sign language generation (SLG) systems increasingly output dense 3D body representations, which better preserve full-body kinematics and geometry for downstream embodiment on humanoid robots. However, these generated motions frequently exhibit self-intersections such as hand-hand and hand-torso penetration. While such artifacts may be tolerated in offline rendering, they become critical in humanoid execution as they lead to infeasible inverse-kinematics (IK) solutions, collisions, and unstable retargeted trajectories. We present a system-level framework that bridges SLG outputs to humanoid joint-space execution via two components. First, we introduce a volumetric SMPL-X collision-mitigation module that projects generated signing motions toward physically plausible configurations while minimally deviating from the original trajectory. Second, we propose a vision-language-guided retargeting algorithm built on an IK backbone: a VLM serves as a visual critic over rendered humanoid motion, identifies embodiment-specific failure modes, and triggers targeted task-space corrections. Our results highlight collision handling and perception-guided refinement as key missing components for reliable humanoid signing.
tldr: A system framework that connects sign language generation to humanoid robot execution using volumetric collision mitigation and vision-language-guided retargeting.
tldr_zh: 一个将手语生成连接到人形机器人执行的系统框架，采用体积碰撞缓解和视觉语言引导的重定向。
summary_zh: 近期的手语生成系统逐渐倾向于输出密集的三维人体表征，从而更完整地保留全身运动学与几何信息，以支持下游仿人机器人的具身化实现。然而，这些生成动作常出现自身碰撞问题，例如手与手、手与躯干的交叉渗透。此类伪影在离线渲染中或许尚可容忍，但在仿人机器人执行过程中会引发关键性问题，导致逆运动学求解不可行、碰撞发生以及重定位轨迹失稳。我们提出一种系统级框架，通过两个核心组件将手语生成输出与仿人机器人的关节空间执行相衔接。首先，我们引入基于体素的SMPL-X碰撞缓解模块，该模块在最小程度偏离原始轨迹的前提下，将生成的手语动作投影至物理合理的构型。其次，我们提出基于逆运动学框架的视觉-语言引导重定位算法：视觉语言模型作为渲染后仿人机器人运动的视觉评判器，识别具身化特有的失效模式，并触发针对性的任务空间修正。实验结果表明，碰撞处理与感知引导优化是实现可靠仿人机器人手语的关键缺失环节。

title: Seg2Grasp: A Robust Modular Suction Grasping in Bin Picking
summary: Current bin picking methods that rely heavily on end-to-end learning often falter when confronted with unfamiliar or complex objects in unstructured environments. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Seg2Grasp, a modular pipeline designed for robust suction grasping in dynamic and cluttered bin scenarios. Seg2Grasp is built on a three-step process: Segmentation, Grasping, and Classification. The Segmentation module employs a Transformer-based model to generate class-agnostic object masks from RGB-D images, ensuring accurate detection across various conditions. The Grasping module uses surface normals and mask proposals to determine the optimal suction points, enhancing grasp success. Finally, the Classification module leverages fine-tuned open-vocabulary Mask-CLIP for precise object identification, enabling versatile handling of diverse objects. Real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that Seg2Grasp outperforms existing methods in success rates and adaptability, establishing it as a powerful tool for automated bin picking in industrial settings.
tldr: Seg2Grasp proposes a modular suction grasping pipeline for bin picking, combining Transformer-based segmentation, surface-normal grasp selection, and open-vocabulary classification with Mask-CLIP.
tldr_zh: Seg2Grasp 提出了一种模块化的吸盘抓取流水线，结合基于Transformer的分割、表面法向量抓取点选择和基于Mask-CLIP的开放词汇分类。
summary_zh: 摘要：当前严重依赖端到端学习的料箱抓取方法，在非结构化环境中面对陌生或复杂物体时经常失效。为克服这些局限性，我们提出Seg2Grasp——一种专为动态杂乱料箱场景中稳健吸盘抓取设计的模块化流程。Seg2Grasp基于三步流程构建：分割、抓取与分类。分割模块采用基于Transformer的模型，从RGB-D图像生成与类别无关的物体掩码，确保在各种条件下实现精准检测。抓取模块利用表面法线与掩码提议确定最优吸盘点，提升抓取成功率。最后，分类模块借助微调后的开放词汇Mask-CLIP实现精确物体识别，从而灵活处理多样物体。真实机器人实验表明，Seg2Grasp在成功率和适应性方面均优于现有方法，成为工业场景中自动化料箱抓取的强大工具。

title: Predicting Grasping Compliance in Robotic Hands through Analytical-Model-Informed Neural Networks
summary: In robotic manipulation studies, grasping is often treated as a binary success or failure problem, usually defined by whether the object simply stays in the hand. For forceful tool use, however, this view is insufficient because grasp compliance becomes a critical factor governing how the hand and tool behave under load. Compliance arises from coupled kinematics, grasp configuration, passive mechanics, and contact conditions, producing nonlinear behavior in which deformation and interaction forces influence each other. Understanding this relationship is essential for predictive models of how a grasped tool and a compliant hand jointly respond to external loading. In underactuated hands, these effects are amplified: such designs offer low cost and adaptive grasping, but make compliance behavior more difficult to model and predict. Our goal is therefore to develop a predictive model for grasped tool behavior during forceful interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce an analytical model informed neural network (AMINN), a hybrid predictive model that combines an analytical mechanics layer with data driven learning to estimate grasp stability and in hand tool displacement under external loading. The model is evaluated on a three finger underactuated robotic hand and shows strong predictive capability with mechanically meaningful outputs across diverse loading conditions. Compared with a black box multilayer perceptron baseline, AMINN also achieves better energy based physical consistency. Beyond prediction accuracy alone, this framework advances physically interpretable learning for robotic manipulation and supports more reliable, safer, and more trustworthy autonomous tool use in safety critical settings during forceful interaction.
tldr: Proposes an analytical-model-informed neural network (AMINN) that combines mechanics with data-driven learning to predict grasp compliance and in-hand tool displacement for underactuated robotic hands under external loading.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种分析模型指导的神经网络（AMINN），结合力学与数据驱动学习，预测欠驱动机械手在外力加载下的抓取顺应性和工具位移。
summary_zh: 在机器人操作研究中，抓取通常被视为一个二元成功或失败问题，其判定标准往往是物体是否简单地保持在手中。然而，对于需要施加力的工具使用场景，这种观点并不充分，因为抓取柔顺性成为控制手部与工具在负载下行为的关键因素。柔顺性源于耦合运动学、抓取构型、被动力学及接触条件，会产生非线性行为——变形与接触力相互影响。理解这一关系对于建立预测模型至关重要，该模型需描述被夹持工具与柔顺手部如何共同响应外部载荷。在欠驱动手中，这些效应被放大：此类设计虽成本低且能自适应抓取，却使柔顺行为的建模与预测更为困难。因此，我们的目标是开发一种在强力交互过程中预测被夹持工具行为的模型。为应对这一挑战，我们提出分析模型引导的神经网络（AMINN），这是一种融合分析力学层与数据驱动学习的混合预测模型，可评估外部载荷下的抓取稳定性及工具在手内的位移。该模型在三指欠驱动机械手上进行了评估，展现出强大的预测能力，能在多种载荷条件下输出具有力学意义的预测结果。与黑箱多层感知机基线模型相比，AMINN在基于能量的物理一致性方面表现更优。除预测精度外，该框架还推动了机器人操作中物理可解释学习的发展，支持在安全关键场景中实现更可靠、更安全且更值得信赖的自主工具使用。

title: Reinforcement Learning: From Algorithms To Foundation Models
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a framework for sequential decision making under explicit objectives. In its classical form, RL studies how an agent should act to maximise long-term reward in a dynamic environment. In richer settings, the problem extends beyond a single agent and fixed environment: intelligent behavior may require strategic interaction, adaptation to uncertainty, and reasoning over high-dimensional worlds. This thesis studies RL from two perspectives: algorithms in games and RL in the era of foundation models.
  The first part focuses on multi-agent RL in games. It examines how incentives, policies, and equilibrium concepts interact in competitive and general-sum environments, spanning two-player zero-sum games, large-scale video games, and multi-player settings with general structure. These works investigate learning in multi-agent systems and the behavior of RL methods in interactive environments. The second part studies RL with generative and foundation models, motivated by the idea that prior knowledge can enrich sequential decision making. Pretrained generative models and learned world models serve as representation tools and structured priors for planning, control, and policy optimization. The thesis develops diffusion-based world models, investigates RL for efficient video generation, explores generative models as policy classes, and studies interactive video world models in which actions shape future observations. It also addresses long-horizon modeling through architectures with memory. Together, these contributions present a unified view of RL as objective-driven adaptation in complex sequential domains. From strategic games to generative world models, the thesis highlights how RL connects decision making, environment modeling, and emerging foundation-model capabilities, offering a broader perspective on the principles underlying intelligent behavior.
tldr: This thesis studies reinforcement learning from two perspectives: multi-agent RL in games and RL with generative/foundation models for decision making, including diffusion-based world models and video world models for control.
tldr_zh: 本论文从两个角度研究强化学习：博弈中的多智能体RL，以及基于生成模型/基础模型的RL用于决策，包括基于扩散的世界模型和用于控制的可交互视频世界模型。
summary_zh:
强化学习（RL）为在明确目标下进行序列决策提供了框架。其经典形式研究智能体如何在动态环境中采取行动以最大化长期回报。在更复杂的设定中，问题超越了单一智能体和固定环境：智能行为可能需要策略互动、对不确定性的适应以及在高维世界中的推理。本论文从两个角度研究强化学习：博弈中的算法与基础模型时代的强化学习。

第一部分关注博弈中的多智能体强化学习。它探讨了在竞争与一般和环境中，激励、策略与均衡概念如何相互作用，涵盖两人零和博弈、大规模视频游戏以及具有一般结构的多玩家设定。这些研究考察了多智能体系统中的学习过程以及强化学习方法在交互环境中的行为。第二部分研究基于生成模型与基础模型的强化学习，其动机在于先验知识能够丰富序列决策。预训练生成模型与学习到的世界模型被用作表征工具及用于规划、控制与策略优化的结构化先验。本论文开发了基于扩散的世界模型，研究了用于高效视频生成的强化学习，探索了作为策略类别的生成模型，并研究了动作塑造未来观测的交互式视频世界模型。它还通过具有记忆的架构解决了长时域建模问题。这些贡献共同呈现了强化学习作为复杂序列领域中目标驱动适应的统一视角。从策略博弈到生成世界模型，本论文凸显了强化学习如何将决策制定、环境建模与新兴基础模型能力相连接，为理解智能行为背后的原理提供了更广阔的视角。

title: Thinking in Video: Can Video Generators Really Reason About the Real World?
summary: Recent advances in world models and video generation have given rise to an emerging reasoning paradigm that leverages video generative models to simulate, predict, and reason about real-world dynamics. We redefine this paradigm as Thinking in Video, where video is not merely an output artifact but a medium for constructing, extending, and verifying causal thought. However, this promise remains unverified: convincing rollouts may reflect memorized appearances rather than causal understanding, while existing metrics separate perceptual fidelity from semantic logic. To evaluate whether video generators support such reasoning, we introduce the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ), auditing World Model Consistency from two perspectives. Explicit Causal Perception tests whether a generator reads a video scenario as a reasoning problem through spatio-temporal flattened visual question answering, while Implicit Generative Perception-Prediction Gap evaluates whether it renders the causal consequence as a consistent future video. Applying CGDJ to representative open- and closed-source generators reveals a clear Perception-Prediction Gap: open-source models produce plausible dynamics despite near-zero explicit causal perception, whereas advanced closed-source systems show stronger but still limited alignment between reasoning and generation. Further analysis exposes audio-visual misalignment, where models verbalize correct causal logic more reliably than they render it, challenging the "world simulator" narrative.
tldr: This paper introduces the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ) audit to evaluate whether video generative models can genuinely reason about real-world dynamics, revealing a gap between plausible video generation and explicit causal understanding.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了因果-生成双重裁判（CGDJ）审计，用于评估视频生成模型是否能真正推理现实世界的动态，揭示了看似合理的视频生成与明确因果理解之间的差距。
summary_zh: 世界模型与视频生成的最新进展催生了一种新兴的推理范式，该范式利用视频生成模型来模拟、预测和推理现实世界的动态变化。我们将这一范式重新定义为"视频思维"——视频不再仅仅是输出的产物，而是构建、延展和验证因果思维的媒介。然而，这一愿景尚未得到验证：看似合理的推演结果可能反映的是记忆中的表象而非因果理解，而现有评估指标则将感知逼真度与语义逻辑相分离。为评估视频生成器是否真正支持此类推理，我们提出了"因果-生成双裁判"（CGDJ）方法，从两个维度审计世界模型的一致性。显式因果感知测试通过时空展开的视觉问答，检验生成器是否将视频场景解读为推理问题；隐式生成感知-预测差距则评估生成器是否将因果后果呈现为连贯的未来视频。将CGDJ应用于代表性开源与闭源生成器后，我们发现了一个显著的"感知-预测差距"：开源模型虽能生成看似合理的动态变化，但其显式因果感知能力近乎为零；而先进的闭源系统虽展现出更强的因果推理与生成一致性，但仍存在明显局限。进一步分析揭示了视听错位现象——模型在语言化正确因果逻辑时的可靠性高于视觉呈现，这挑战了"世界模拟器"的叙事框架。

title: Generalize and Guide: Decomposing Rewards for Few-Shot Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a powerful framework for learning from demonstrations. However, real-world tasks often exhibit substantial natural variations (e.g., picking up mugs with varying shapes), making it impractical to collect demonstrations that fully specify a new task under every possible scenario. In practice, while demonstrations for the target task are limited, it is often easier to obtain datasets of heterogeneous but related behaviors. This motivates the problem of few-shot IRL with multi-task demonstrations (FM-IRL), where an agent must learn a new task with substantial variations from only a limited number of target-task demonstrations, together with sufficient demonstrations of related tasks and online agent experience. To do so, we must both recover the expert distribution of the new task and provide guidance when the agent deviates from it.
